title: Zelensky Speaks With Trump Envoys Witkoff and Kushner on Day 1,715
detail: EA WorldView reports that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky spoke with US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner on day 1,715 of the war. Content of the conversation was not available in the aggregated summary; single-source report, unconfirmed.

title: Zelensky: Oleshky Truce Shows 'When Putin Wants, the Fighting Stops'
detail: Per Le Monde's live coverage, Zelensky said the Oleshky truce proves that when Putin wants, the fighting stops. The same report says Kremlin envoy Kirill Dmitriev presented Melania Trump with a painting in recognition of the Oleshky ceasefire. Single-source live-blog report.

title: UK Refuses to Invite Putin to G20 Summit, Breaking With Trump
detail: The UK is reported to have broken with President Trump by refusing to invite Vladimir Putin to the G20 summit. Single aggregated-feed report; details unconfirmed.
